rules.statement: Partition proceedings are not intended to determine contested questions of title but rather for those whose shares in the land are admitted at least to some extent.
rules.supporting_quote: The primary object of partition proceedings is not to try and determine contested questions of title, and a contest as to title should not be made the subject of such proceedings. They are really meant for those whose shares in the land are admitted at least to some extent.

meta.parties: Nona Baba v. Namohamy Et Al
